basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in Algiers, I'm a 33-year-old software developer with a passion for gaming and neurophilosophy. I studied computer science at the University of Algiers and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. When I'm not coding or gaming, you can find me exploring the philosophical aspects of neuroscience. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings, especially after work hours. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time with my cat, Whiskers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and a career in software development, I have a strong foundation in technology. My interest in neurophilosophy stems from self-study and online courses, where I explore the intersection of mind, brain, and artificial intelligence.
